The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. Modelled diversion is not observed post-policy behaviour. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
